evidence_excerpts: 1. CustomTune technology automatically analyzes ear canal acoustics upon power-up and calibrates ANC filters.
2. Testing conducted by Bose with active noise cancellation on and audio playback at 75 dB SPL. Battery life is reduced to ~18 hours when Immersive Audio is continuously engaged.
3. Snapdragon Sound support requires a compatible Android device with Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 or newer processor.
4. Quick charging requires a minimum 5V/3A USB-A or USB-C power source.
